title: 《绝区零》主线承载方式变更的合成发行压力测试
brief: Using the documented TV Mode pacing criticism and the reported developer response only as a historical mechanism, compile a fictional next-version ZZZ scenario in which a new main-story presentation system interrupts combat flow. Compare delayed silence against a fast explanation, bounded adjustment, localized communication, and follow-up review. Do not claim that this event will occur.

strategyLabels.candidate: 解释 + 有界调整 + 本地化沟通 + 后续复盘

successCriteria: Every historical statement resolves to a claim and public source URL.
Every scenario number is bound to evidence or an explicit synthetic assumption.
The same compiled input and seed reproduce the same 42-day run.
The result compares two strategies and identifies the groups, mechanisms, and days that create the divergence.
The 3D observer consumes the generated artifact without inventing unavailable channels.
boundaries: This is a scenario stress test, not a forecast or a real-world probability estimate.
The historical case is an analogy; the fictional next-version event is explicitly synthetic.
Regional factors remain 1.0 unless direct regional evidence is added.
No claim is made about the prevalence of player opinion.
openEvidenceGaps: Directly archive an accessible official developer statement or video transcript.
Replace the Japanese search-index lead with a directly checked Japanese source.
Add Chinese and Japanese primary/community materials about the same mechanism before claiming three-language semantic comparison.
